lean.fidelity_note: The formal statement retains all six coefficient families and estimates (5.7)–(5.8), while allowing any smooth periodic pressure meeting the residual and coercivity bounds; the zero-mean Poisson pressure fixed in §5.1 is a special case. One exponent $C$ is chosen before the parent and derivative order, and the composition constants depend only on the prescribed derivative bounds for $f$. Operator norms replace sums of coordinate derivatives, with the order-dependent comparison absorbed in $C_m$; the explicit condition $0<\ell_*\le\mathsf D^{-C}$ supplies the small radius used in the paper.
